card.name: The verb use before machines or substances
card.fires_on: The verb "use" or "using" in label warnings, mostly right before an object such as machines, alcohol, opioids or oral contraceptives. It often follows "drive or" or "women who".

modes.label: Use machines
modes.description: "use" after driving, in warnings about operating machines.
modes.example: This may include impairment of a patient's ability to drive or<< use>> machines immediately after infusion.

modes.label: Women who use a drug
modes.description: "use" or "using" after a patient group, before a drug or substance.
modes.example: Women who<< use>> oral contraceptives should be strongly advised

modes.label: Avoid use of substance
modes.example: advise patients to not<< use>> alcohol until the following day.

card.writes: It lowers the chance of the next word being tools, technology or instruments, so "use" is read as a verb about taking a drug or operating machines.
card.plain: It marks the word "use" in warnings about driving, machines, alcohol or taking a medicine.
